changelog:
- Initial release of the "job-analysis-future" skill for supporting Chapter 10 ("The Future of Job Analysis") learning and discussion from book 《Job and Work Analysis》.
- Provides targeted assistance for topics like future trends, impacts of technology, flexible/virtual/gig roles, AI, automation, electronic monitoring, job crafting, and evolving work analysis methods.
- Employs progressive disclosure: first diagnoses user needs, then supplies chapter structure, main concepts, or practical frameworks as required.
- Uses clear, example-based Chinese explanations and directs users to detailed references or cases only when deeper detail is needed.
- Ensures accurate alignment with textbook perspectives, avoiding unsupported predictions or extra-textbook data.
